title: App Engine standard and flexible: what remains, and when it fits

videos.script: App Engine is older than Compute Engine, and it began with an idea the industry took years to copy. You hand over source code, and Google does the rest. {{standard}} First, the standard environment. Two files describe the shop's storefront, and the start command runs on your laptop exactly as written. {{versions}} Then the shape of an application. Services, versions and instances, and traffic split between two versions by a cookie. {{flexible}} Then the flexible environment. A container on machines App Engine manages, which never scales to zero, and what that costs in a month. {{remains}} Last, what remains. One application per project, in one region, forever. And the honest answer to when App Engine is still the right home.
